newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-SAMPRAS WARMS UP TO WIN OPEN CLASH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS WARMS UP TO WIN OPEN CLASH.

text.p: World number one and top seed Pete Sampras saw off Romanian challenger Adrian Voinea on Thursday, winning a place in the third round of the Australian Open with a 3-6 6-2 6-3 6-2 win.

Sampras showed rare signs of vulnerability as Voinea, ranked 48, played an all-or-nothing first set. The American, who won the tournament in 1994, had little reply to Voinea's penetrating passes around the court.
But he quickly pulled himself together and served a total of 14 aces as he sped through the next three sets to set up a third-round tie against Australian doubles specialist Mark Woodforde.
Voinea had almost as many break points in the match as did Sampras, but only managed to convert two of seven before surrendering the match with a backhand return into the net.
